personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center optimized for OLED smartwatch readability, immediate target acquisition, and instant haptic feedback.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 56pt height) required for smartwatch UI. Padding ensures clear hit zones without accidental taps.

do's: Use flat solid colors for maximum OLED contrast and battery savings
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism as it reduces readability on tiny screens in direct sunlight

screens.name: Main Match Timer (En Juego)
screens.purpose: Live match control surface displaying giant timer and quick event logging.

states.error: Error resetting timer, standard retry button

screens.layout: Top-aligned metadata (period, added time). Giant center-aligned countdown/countup timer taking ~40% of screen height. Below it, a row or 3-column pill-shaped button grid spanning the width: Green [+GOL], Yellow [TARJETA], Blue [CAMBIO]. Dedicated Pause/Resume control just below the timer or triggered by long-press. Pure black background (#000000).

screens.name: Card Flow - Player Selection
screens.purpose: Numpad layout to quickly input a player's dorsal number (1-99).
screens.layout: Grid numpad (large touch targets) occupying main screen space. A display at the top shows the current typed number. Bottom right has a 'Confirm' CTA (Check icon). Haptic feedback on every number tap.

screens.name: Card Flow - Card Selection
screens.purpose: Select between Yellow or Red card to finalize logging.
screens.layout: Split screen or two massive vertical buttons. Top half/Button 1: Warning Yellow (#EAB308) for Amarilla. Bottom half/Button 2: Error Red (#EF4444) for Roja. Tapping triggers intense haptic feedback, saves event [Minuto]-[Dorsal]-[Tarjeta], and pops back to Main Timer.

screens.name: Match Summary (Resumen)
screens.purpose: Post-match or paused state to view a clean timeline of all logged events.

states.empty: Watermarked referee whistle image overlay with 'No events logged yet' text.

screens.layout: Vertical flat list. Each row contains [Minute] on the left, [Event Icon] center, [Dorsal/Team] right. A sticky bottom CTA 'Fin de Partido' in pure red (#EF4444) to end the match. Pure black background with dark gray separators (#1A1A1A).

summary_empty_state.alt: Referee holding yellow card in field

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT: The background MUST be pure black (#000000) at the root level to satisfy the OLED battery-saving constraint for smartwatch apps.
Implement Bebas Neue for the giant timer text. The timer text must be huge (e.g., 80pt) and visually centered.
Use Phosphor icons. All touch targets must be at least 56x56pt.
Buttons for + GOL, TARJETA, and CAMBIO must distinctly use their designated semantic colors: Green (#22C55E), Yellow (#EAB308), and Blue (#3B82F6) respectively.
For the Card logging flow, separate it into quick modal or stack screens: Numpad -> Card Color. Wire up haptics per the haptics block for every interaction.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur effects. Keep the UI flat, tactical, and high-contrast.
